dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, could it be because the Glaciafruit were too cold?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Oh, that's what you mean. Well, nothing to be done about that. Think about it. Down there, anything you carry with you to eat is going to end up frozen solid anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Look at it that way, and chewing on Glaciafruit is much easier than gnawing on rye bread frozen hard as stone! They're crunchy, like eating ice cream, and they're more nutritious too!

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Of course, the main reason is that I just like them! Haha, you should definitely try one sometime, my friend!
